Cycron.desc: Forgo ammunition with the regenerating energy disc in this plasma throwing pistol.

Despair.desc: Used by The Stalker, Despair throwing blades have a mono-filament edge, sharp enough to penetrate a Warframe.

Detron.desc: The sleek lines of the Detron conceal its ferocious nature. The hand cannon's semi-automatic action takes down enemies with speed and efficiency.

Dex Furis.desc: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.

Dual Cestra.desc: Wield two Cestras to unleash a dual torrent of high energy bolts.

Dual Coda Torxica.desc: Get the job done right with a pair of spore flinging terror tools. Inflicts a spore that spreads to nearby enemies on death causing <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status Effect and increased vulnerability to damage from the Torxi

Dual Toxocyst.desc: Brain-strikes excite this bioweapon, causing it to rapidly release toxic munitions.

Efv-8 Mars.desc: The standard issue personal Efervon projector, as sported by all ranks of Scaldra.

Embolist.desc: A living weapon, the infested Embolist pistol kills its victims with an acidic venomous gas.

Epitaph.desc: Sevagoth's wrist-mounted sidearm fires a chilling slow-moving slab, guaranteed to slow enemies for easier marksmanship. Charge the shot to fire a punishing high-velocity, high critical chance slab that punches through ba

Epitaph Prime.desc: Send shivers down your enemies' spines with this wrist-mounted sidearm. As the signature weapon of Sevagoth Prime, it deals additional headshot damage when wielded by him.

Euphona Prime.desc: Banshee Prime's signature shotgun is an instrument of devastation that fires both focused and broad shots.

Furis.desc: The Furis delivers a high damage output in a short time frame thanks to its high rate of fire.

Fusilai.desc: Silently lacerate enemies with Gara's signature glass throwing knives. Increased Projectile Speed when wielded by Gara.

Gammacor.desc: Designed to quickly vaporize minerals for content analysis, users discovered its powerful beam was equally efficient at dispatching hostiles.

Grimoire.desc: Claim the power of Albrecht Entrati's knowledge. Customize the Grimoire with Tome Mods that enhance Warframe Abilities and reward strategic combat. Its alternate attack releases a voltaic orb with guaranteed <DT_ELECTRIC

Hikou.desc: As an alternative to Kunai, these Tenno throwing stars do cause less Damage but they come with expanded Ammo Capacity and a higher Fire Rate.

Hikou Prime.desc: As deadly as any bullet without the associated noise or commotion.

Hystrix.desc: Heat, cold, electricity, or toxin: choose an element and launch a flurry of deadly quills. This versatile sidearm is Khora’s signature weapon and has a chance to instantly reload after headshots when she wields it.

Hystrix Prime.desc: Versatile weapons complement deadly hunters. Khora Prime’s signature pistol rotates through hot, cold, electric, and toxic quills. When equipped on Khora, Hystrix Prime has a chance to instantly reload after headshots.

Knell.desc: Ring the death knell. Headshots briefly turn this scoped pistol into a rapid-fire, Critical Damage fiend that uses no ammo. When used by Harrow, Knell has a 2-round mag.

Knell Prime.desc: Ring a funeral toll upon enemy skulls with Harrow Prime's signature pistol.

Kohmak.desc: Like the larger Kohm, this hand-shotgun doubles its volley with each successive shot.

Kompressa.desc: Launch a volley of virulent, hyper-pressurized, water globules that envelope targets and explode with torrential force. Yareli's signature pistol.

Kompressa Prime.desc: Glinting like a golden dawn, Yareli Prime’s signature pistol engulfs foes in a cascade of virulent, explosive, water globules. None can escape the sea.

Kraken.desc: The Kraken is a heavy pistol of Grineer design that fires two quick shots with a single pull of the trigger. Skilled marksmen will appreciate the value in this deadly accurate weapon.

Kulstar.desc: Rain hell on the enemy with this handheld cluster-rocket launcher.

Kunai.desc: Kunai throwing daggers offer a silent alternative to the traditional side arm. Perfect for assassins.

Kuva Brakk.desc: This Lich-variant semi-automatic hand cannon delivers a lot of punch in a small package. Higher fire rate, magazine capacity and reload speed.

Kuva Kraken.desc: A custom variant that fires three quick shots with a single pull of the trigger, or can alt-fire burst the remainder of its magazine. Higher Fire Rate, Magazine Capacity and Reload Speed.

Kuva Nukor.desc: A highly-optimized Nukor that allows for the weapon’s microwave field to hit up to two additional targets.

Kuva Seer.desc: This variant pistol has higher fire rate and magazine capacity. Superior zoom capabilities plus projectiles have a small Corrosive burst.

Kuva Twin Stubbas.desc: Double-fist rapid-fire bursts of pain with these dual-wield variants of the Grineer submachine gun. Higher Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity.

Laetum.desc: During parades and victory marches, the Laetum fired pigmented airburst rounds that rained onto festive crowds. The Orokin sent Laetum with the Zariman so they could properly celebrate a successful maiden voyage to Tau.

Lato.desc: The Lato is a highly accurate pistol used by the Tenno everywhere.

Lato Prime.desc: The Lato is a highly accurate pistol used by the Tenno everywhere. Prime model offers slightly increased damage.

Lato Vandal.desc: A special version of the standard Lato pistol with a slower Fire Rate but offering higher Accuracy and Damage values. The Lato Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding

Lex.desc: The Lex is a powerful, accurate pistol that has a low Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity. Very efficient at long range.

Lex Prime.desc: The Lex Prime is a powerful, accurate pistol that has a low Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity. Very efficient at long range.

Magnus.desc: The versatile Magnus revolver is a lethal sidearm for any Tenno.

Magnus Prime.desc: Orokin elegance meets formidable stopping power in this exquisite revolver. Hits have a chance to give Infinite Ammo for a few seconds.

Mara Detron.desc: For Orokin-era smugglers, this fearsome handheld shotgun was a favored tool for 'dispute resolution'.

Marelok.desc: The Marelok combines the stopping power of a rifle with the portability of a pistol.

Mk1-Furis.desc: The MK1-Furis are the standard issue automatic pistol for all Tenno.

Mk1-Kunai.desc: The MK1-Kunai is the standard issue throwing knives for all Tenno.

Nukor.desc: Creates and focuses a high-frequency field of microwaves, literally cooking the target from within.

Ocucor.desc: A weapon that reaches for its next victim even as it kills. With each takedown, this pistol spawns an energy tendril that reaches for a nearby target.

Onos.desc: Albrecht's Void experiments revealed the true destructive potential of this weapon. In Incarnon form, draw in ambient power to deal steadily increased damage to enemies. At full power, release a blast of <DT_FIRE_COLOR>H

Pandero.desc: Octavia's pistol hammers foes with single shots or a rapid volley of bullets. When wielded by Octavia, alt-fire Headshot Kills increase Reload Speed.

Pandero Prime.desc: Pound the beat for a dance of death with Octavia's signature prime pistol.

Plinx.desc: Cultivate a meaningful relationship with this deceptively simple battery-powered pistol. The Plinx rewards attention and investment from the wise.

Pox.desc: These festering sacs of pus and gas burst violently on impact.

Prisma Angstrum.desc: Imbued with the finest Prisma crystal, this refined Angstrum features boosted charge and reload speeds.

Prisma Twin Gremlins.desc: Fused with prisma crystals, these pristine Grineer sidearms are sure to intimidate any foe.

Pyrana.desc: Chew through the enemy with this vicious automatic hand shotgun.

Pyrana Prime.desc: Three kills in rapid succession to summon a second ethereal Pyrana for twice the deadly punch.

Quatz.desc: A compact four-barreled design packing a self-charging capacitor that discharges upon every reload from empty. Features auto hip-fire and aimed fire is semi-auto, four-shot instant burst.

Rakta Ballistica.desc: This modified ballistica is the weapon of choice used by Red Veil Assassins to take out high-priority marks.

Riot-848.desc: Never stop fighting, never run out of ammo. Temple's signature machine pistol was modified by Albrecht Entrati to warp fired bullets back into the magazine when reloaded.

Sagek Prime.desc: The sidearm of choice for Prime Grineer warriors, Sagek Prime blends Grineer brutality with Orokin aesthetics. When Sagek Prime inflicts a critical hit, its next shot has a chance to gain significant Status Chance.

Sancti Castanas.desc: This remotely detonated electrical trap is used by devotees of New Loka to protect their temples and shrines.

Scyotid.desc: Go on the hunt with Oraxia’s signature secondary. Fling a volley of toxin-laced barbs, or drop a cluster snare that scatters on impact, seizing nearby enemies and dragging them together.

Secura Dual Cestra.desc: The favored side-arms of Perrin Sequence executives, these pistols have been modified to improve efficiency and killing potential.

Seer.desc: Captain Vor's prized Orokin-Grineer hybrid pistol has an average rate of fire, but it has high damage and superior zoom capabilities.

Sepulcrum.desc: An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating secondary fire. This large, weighty double-barreled pistol delivers twin projectiles that pack a punch, e

Sicarus.desc: The Sicarus fires 3-round bursts, which provides a balance between the lethality of auto-pistols and the accuracy of semi-automatic pistols.

Sicarus Prime.desc: The Sicarus Prime is an ornamental firearm that fires rounds in rapid bursts, providing a balance between the lethality of auto-pistols and the accuracy of semi-automatic pistols.

Sonicor.desc: Blasts targets with a massive wave of sonic energy. Results reported to be: 'Very Satisfying'.

Spectra.desc: While its intended design is for deep space construction, the concentrated laser beam of the Spectra is highly effective against organic and synthetic enemies.

Spectra Vandal.desc: A special-order Corpus cutting tool for master crafters only. Features distinctive azurite plating and a focusing crystal of precision clarity and cut.

Spira.desc: A flash of red ribbon is the last thing most victims of these throwing-daggers see.

Spira Prime.desc: These rare, braided throwing daggers were a favorite tool of high ranking Orokin assassins.

Staticor.desc: Send a massive charge of potential energy hurling toward unfortunate targets.

Stubba.desc: Inflict rapid-fire bursts of pain with this Grineer submachine gun.

Stug.desc: Firing a sticky, toxic, explosive compound, the Stug Gel Gun offers multiple ejection modes, delivering maximum damage in all situations.

Synoid Gammacor.desc: Deployed by the Cephalon Suda, once a data-analyzing instrument the Gammacor main focus is defense.

Talons.desc: The claws of these tactical bombs dig into the target and detonate on command.

Telos Akbolto.desc: For the Arbiters of Hexis these pistols are more than simple weapons, they are symbols of truth and discipline.

Tenet Cycron.desc: This reengineered Cycron features a refracting energy disc that can split off the main target, hitting up to 2 additional nearby targets.

Tenet Detron.desc: Parvos Granum's engineers have made this already ferocious hand cannon even more deadly with the addition of an alternate fire mode that empties an entire clip in one devastating burst.

Tenet Diplos.desc: Itemize and execute with this pair of auto-lock-on, homing-projectile pistols. Shoot from-hip for a more conventional pistol experience. The patented Granum Attaché System reloads the pistols when holstered.

Tenet Plinx.desc: Alternate fire on this reengineered Plinx fires a projectile that pulls enemies close and then explodes. Its cooldown increases after the explosion to accommodate battery power demands.

Tenet Spirex.desc: Dominate rivals with this pistol’s lightning fast rail-slugs. Head-shots speed up reload.

Twin Grakatas.desc: When one Grakata isn't enough, bring another for extra firepower.

Twin Gremlins.desc: Designed as a pair, these Grineer sidearms fire projectiles at a slower rate but with greater force and accuracy.

Twin Kohmak.desc: Doubling their volley on each successive shot, the Twin Kohmaks decimate foes in seconds.

Twin Rogga.desc: These twin barrels of destruction are the signature pistols of the Kuva Guardians.

Twin Vipers.desc: A Viper equipped in each hand.

Twin Vipers Wraith.desc: The uniquely styled Twin Vipers Wraith are a powerful variation on the standard akimbo machine-pistols.

Tysis.desc: The Tysis pistol spits out caustic darts that corrode their victims from within.

Vasto.desc: Steady and reliable, the Vasto revolver combines speed and power for a classic gunslinger feel.

Vasto Prime.desc: This elegant rapid-fire revolver is the embodiment of superior Orokin craftsmanship.

Vaykor Marelok.desc: Taken from defeated Grineer commanders and rebuilt to improve combat efficiency and reliability.

Velox.desc: With a high fire rate, ammo efficiency and rapid reload when emptied, this unusual sidearm can hand out carnage all day long. Ammo efficiency is further increased when Protea uses this, her signature weapon.

Velox Prime.desc: This sidearm’s circular design evokes Protea Prime’s perception of time.

Vesper 77.desc: A true masterpiece of Höllvanian engineering, Vesper 77's advanced laser sight highlights enemy Weak Points with precision. Aim to increase its Critical Damage Multiplier.

Viper.desc: A full-auto pistol known as the most compact and lightweight weapon of the Grineer arsenal. Though it has a small Magazine Capacity, the Viper has a very high Fire Rate and ultra-fast reload times thanks to a simplified

Viper Wraith.desc: The uniquely styled Viper Wraith is a powerful variation on the standard machine-pistol.

Zakti.desc: Fires razor-sharp darts that anchor themselves in their target before erupting in a plume of toxic gas.

Zakti Prime.desc: A thousand pains, before their end.

Zylok.desc: Hammer the enemy with this light-bodied heavy hitter. Featuring a double-action trigger that fires hard and fast.

Zylok Prime.desc: A lightweight weapon that packs a punch worthy of its golden design.

Zymos.desc: Infect your foes with this spore-scattering pistol. Headshots burrow in and explode, releasing spore clouds that seek out nearby enemies.

Ack & Brunt.desc: Tyl Regor's custom axe and shield are how he likes to eliminate ‘frustrations'.

Amanata.desc: Roll Koumei's die with every 30 hits from Amanata to empower yourself with 1 of 5 Koumei blessings. Roll a 6 to receive all blessings at once.

Amphis.desc: Fashioned with Grineer materials and balanced for marine infantry use, the Amphis is a traditional staff weapon that has received a monstrous makeover that enables shock damage on jump attacks. Connects with multiple ene

Anku.desc: Reap havoc with this full sized Tenno-crafted scythe.

Ankyros.desc: A pair of mighty gauntlets, the Ankyros were designed by the Tenno for close quarters combat. What they lack in range they make up for in speed.

Ankyros Prime.desc: This Orokin variation of the Ankyros is superior to its successor in every way.

Arca Titron.desc: Each successive kill from this massive electron hammer builds an electron charge that is unleashed on slam attacks.

Argo & Vel.desc: Argo & Vel bolster the warrior who stands fast. Its Heavy Attack sends forth a glaive that ricochets off enemies.

Arum Spinosa.desc: Slash through enemies with two leaves of the exceedingly rare Arum Spinosa plant. Heavy Attack to whip a flurry of toxic spines at ranged attackers.

Atterax.desc: A multi-bladed whip that is adept at flaying skin from bone. In extreme cases, disobedient Grineer are sentenced to death by Atterax.

Azothane.desc: Azothane calls the visionary warrior to turn the tides of battle. Block and melee attack at the same time to plunge Azothane into the ground, damaging nearby enemies with a shockwave and adding to the combo counter.

Bo.desc: A two-handed, reinforced staff that can send multiple enemies airborne.

Bo Prime.desc: A classic Orokin weapon, Bo Prime creates elegant fury on the battlefield.

Boltace.desc: An intimidating Tonfa set designed to match the briary design of the Boltor.

Broken Scepter.desc: A shattered talisman of the Grineer Elder Queen. It pulls health orbs from deceased enemies and energy orbs from destroyed robots.

Broken War.desc: A fragment of Stalker's War sword, a symbol of his defeat.

Cadus.desc: A lone Tenno once used this staff to fight back a horde of Infested.

Cassowar.desc: Light and nimble, the twin blades of this polearm will swoop and slice through throngs of hardened foes.

Caustacyst.desc: Heavy attacks from this scythe unleash a wave of acid that mutilates enemies and leaves a trail of corrosive sludge.

Ceramic Dagger.desc: This short blade weapon was built using ceramic. It has limited range but comes out fast.

Cerata.desc: Twisted and tortured from exposure to the Infestation, this glaive becomes an absolute predator in the hands of the right Tenno.

Ceti Lacera.desc: Forged for veterans of the Scarlet Spear conflict, this Lacera has been modified to enhance nimbleness and lethality.

Cobra & Crane.desc: Baruuk's signature weapons: a sword for retribution, a shield for restraint. In Baruuk's hands, and his hands only, Cobra's first strike in a combo renders his foe unconscious.

Cobra & Crane Prime.desc: Punish those who test your restraint. The first strike in a combo stuns enemies when Cobra & Crane Prime are wielded by Baruuk.

Coda Caustacyst.desc: The Coda Caustacyst scythe is a force to be reckoned with, the Technocyte virus honing it with improved Damage, Status Chance, and Critical Damage, as well as acid pools with longer duration.

Coda Hirudo.desc: Rip and shred your enemies to pieces with the Coda Hirudo. With improved Damage, Status Chance, Critical Chance, and Critical Damage.

Coda Mire.desc: The Plague Year of 1999 will never be the same. With improved Critical Multipler, Critical Chance, and Status Chance, the Technocyte virus has turned the Coda Mire into a truly horrifying blade.

Coda Motovore.desc: Drive home the pain with this hammer evolved from a scooter assembly. The wheel shapeshifts and gains a unique buff to match whatever type of physical damage it has been modded for.

Coda Pathocyst.desc: Enhanced by Technocyte mutations, the Coda Pathocyst comes with increased Damage, Critical Chance, Critical Damage and Status Chance. While in-flight or on contact with the enemy, it will occasionally spawn enhanced, ene

Corufell.desc: Heavy attacks briefly transform the Corufell into a Gunblade. After the Gunblade fires, the Corufell returns to its Heavy Scythe state. Its transformation is fastest in Citrine's hands.

Corufell Prime.desc: Corufell Prime's golden vines streamline its transformation for even faster Heavy Attacks.

Cronus.desc: A strong blade forged using ceramic.

Dakra Prime.desc: The Dakra Prime is a Tenno forged weapon, crafted during the time of the Orokin. It is renowned for speed, power and the ability to hit multiple targets.

Dark Dagger.desc: This short blade weapon forged using dark metals has limited range but comes out fast.

Dark Split-Sword.desc: Use as a devastating heavy sword or apply a Dual Melee stance and split the weapon into two ferocious blades.

Dark Sword.desc: A blade forged using dark metals, capable of delivering innate <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage with attacks.

Destreza.desc: Elevate martial combat into an art form with this Tenno rapier.

Destreza Prime.desc: Take mastery to the next level with this primed rapier.

Dex Dakra.desc: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.

Dex Nikana.desc: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the eleventh anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.

Dorrclave.desc: After 10 kills or assists, Dorrclave enters a spectral state that doubles weapon Follow Through and guarantees Status Effects for the next 10 attacks. In Dagath's hands, each active Status Effect heals her slightly.

Dragon Nikana.desc: The Dragon Nikana is forged from ancient Tenno steel. This is a master's weapon, only the most worthy of Tenno may wield it.

Dual Cleavers.desc: Butcher your foes with brutal blades in each hand.

Dual Ether.desc: Fast and precise. The Dual Ether cuts so cleanly that it was considered by the Tenno to be a more humane weapon for ‘cleansing' infested allies. Capable of hitting multiple targets.

Dual Heat Swords.desc: With a Heat Sword in each hand, enemies reach their fiery demise twice as fast. Can connect with multiple targets at once.

Dual Ichor.desc: The fast and brutal Dual Ichor axes will quickly tear through enemies with a high probability of inflicting Critical Damage.

Dual Kamas.desc: Wielding a Kama in each hand brings a savage amount of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage to bear against your enemies.

Dual Kamas Prime.desc: The sensual lines of these golden Kamas have long been celebrated as a masterwork of Tenno weapon smithing.

Dual Keres.desc: Tear through any target with these vicious, claw-like blades. The signature swords of Khora.

Dual Keres Prime.desc: The hunted will meet a quick end when faced with Khora Prime's signature swords. Heavy Attack Efficiency is enhanced when wielded by Khora.

Dual Raza.desc: Razor sharp battle-hatchets, designed to compliment the Soma.

Dual Skana.desc: A shorter Skana in each hand. Can hit multiple targets.

Dual Viciss.desc: Reap what the Techrot have sown with this vicious pair of Scaldra hand-scythes.

Dual Zoren.desc: Short axes held in each hand. High attack speed and can hit multiple targets. Delivers a high percentage of critical strikes.

Dual Zoren Prime.desc: Axes worthy of an executioner, refined to Orokin perfection.

Edun.desc: Edun befits a dextrous warrior. Heavy Attack to throw Edun. Edun explodes after it is embedded in an enemy.

Ekhein.desc: Wield the timeless power of this mighty hammer. Heavy Attacks performed with Ekhein temporarily increase its Damage and Attack Speed.

Endura.desc: The delicate form of this Tenno rapier conceals its ferocious and resilient force.

Ether Daggers.desc: A shorter version of the Ether blade that allows for a more focused attack on a single target.

Ether Reaper.desc: With a blade forged from the same material as the Ether Sword, the Ether Reaper delivers quick death to its victims.

Ether Sword.desc: A single blade for more precision. The Ether Sword cuts so cleanly that it was considered by the Tenno to be a more humane weapon for ‘cleansing' infested allies.

Falcor.desc: Carve through enemies with surgical precision using this Corpus-tech glaive.

Fang.desc: These matching stilettos have increased attack speed and can unleash a flurry of multi-hit attacks.

Fang Prime.desc: A set of ceremonial daggers from the Orokin era, the Fang Prime's blades resonate violently as they strike. This allows them to pierce hardened materials like armor with ease.

Fragor.desc: A large two-handed hammer, the Fragor requires great strength to wield, but impacts with enough force to send groups of enemies tumbling.

Fragor Prime.desc: A beautifully forged instrument of devastation.

Furax.desc: These power gauntlets lack the range of most Melee Weapons, but Furax is far more devastating when you strike an enemy in close combat.

Furax Wraith.desc: These Wraith gauntlets have been augmented for power.

Galariak Prime.desc: Orokin-era Grineer plated their scythes with gold as a symbol of dedication to their Golden Lords. Gains a percentage of Critical Chance with each Status Type affecting the target.

Galatine.desc: With massive charged power and the ability to hit up to five foes in a single swing, the Galatine sword is the heavy artillery of Melee Weapons.

Galatine Prime.desc: Only Tenno were strong enough to wield this noble beast of a weapon.

Galvacord.desc: Shock and maim with this heavyweight retractable whip.

Gazal Machete.desc: Each kill with this swooping blade adds bonus damage to the Djinn Sentinel’s next Fatal Attraction ability. In turn, Fatal Attraction bestows the weapon with a period of <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Damage.

Ghoulsaw.desc: The cruelest of weapons built for the crudest of Grineer soldiers. Rips through metal like flesh, and through flesh like day-old pudding.

Glaive.desc: Dating back to the time of the first Tenno, the Glaive is a uniquely deadly weapon. This multi-bladed disc is not only effective for melee combat; it can also be thrown like a boomerang to cut down enemies at a distance.

Glaive Prime.desc: The Glaive Prime is a deadly and beautiful weapon from the Orokin era. The blades are as effective in close quarters as they are when thrown at distant enemies.

Gram.desc: The heavy two-handed sword known as Gram requires great strength to wield, but it is notorious for its splitting power. Can hit multiple targets with each strike.

Gram Prime.desc: Born anew, the father of swords returns.

Guandao.desc: Harvest the enemy with this towering polearm.

Guandao Prime.desc: That a god might reap a harvest of lives.

Gunsen.desc: Lacerate attackers with two razor sharp warfans.

Gunsen Prime.desc: Command the beauty and lethality of these ornate warfans.

Halikar.desc: This jet powered Grineer throwing mace always comes back to its master and is even capable of disarming targets.

Halikar Wraith.desc: A different take on the throwing mace, the Halikar Wraith features unique styling.

Harmony.desc:
Harmony triumphs over hate. Heavy Attacks condense Status Effect damage into a single instance. Heavy Attack kills empower allies with increased Status Duration.

Experience the true power of Jade's Ensemble when Evenson

Hate.desc: Hate is a scythe with a cruel blade, wielded by The Stalker.

Heat Dagger.desc: This short blade weapon has limited range but comes out fast and can inflict fire damage.

Heat Sword.desc: A strong blade capable of inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage to its foes.

Heliocor.desc: Obtain enlightenment with this massive hammer that performs a Codex scan on each fatal strike. Scans require an equipped Codex Scanner and an available charge.

Hespar.desc: This Heavy Scythe echoes battles of another time. It is far more a weapon of sheer force than one of finesse.

Hirudo.desc: Rip into the enemy with fists of razor sharp cartilage. Steals health with each critical hit.

Innodem.desc: In the early Orokin Empire, elites wore Innodem as a symbolic reminder to defend the defenseless. The tradition fell out of style, but nostalgic elites acknowledged the sentiment in the form of a gift. The Void amplifies

Jat Kittag.desc: Deliver crushing blows with this Grineer built, jet powered mace.

Jat Kusar.desc: Overwhelm hostiles with this jet-powered sickle and razor-chain weapon. Charged strikes ignite an explosive blast at range.

Jaw Sword.desc: A blade with a serrated edge that delivers strong quick attacks.

Kama.desc: The Kama is a Tenno style hatchet, capable of making short work of any foe.

Karyst.desc: Once the blade weapon of choice for an exclusive order of Tenno assassins, the Karyst dagger grew to become a symbol of honor and duty for all Tenno.

Karyst Prime.desc: This master blade is the heavier, oversized and far more lethal version of the signature weapon of an extinct order of Tenno assassins.

Keratinos.desc: Leave your mark with these infected claws with increased heavy attack range. Heavy attack at max combo to keep the extended range and slam radius for 3 minutes.

Kesheg.desc: Slice through mobs of unruly enemies with this fierce halberd; the signature weapon of the Kuva Guardians.

Kestrel.desc: The Kestrel boomerang is a heavy throwing weapon that can knock down enemies at a distance.

Kestrel Prime.desc: With heightened agility and power the Kestrel Prime's heavy attacks easily knock down foes, ensuring none shall stand before it.

Kogake.desc: These coverings for the hands and feet allow devastating high flying hand-to-hand combat attacks without risking harm to the user.

Kogake Prime.desc: Deliver a golden knockout with these prime Melee Weapons.

Korrudo.desc: When they go high, go low. Powerful pneumatic grips and toecaps amplify every blow. Four ways to deal twice the pain.

Korumm.desc: Archon Boreal’s signature trident. Thrust Korumm into the ground with a Tactical Combo and then rip it out in a shower of electricity.

Kreska.desc: This unsophisticated Corpus survival tool does what it was designed for: hacking and splitting whatever it strikes.

Krohkur.desc: This hooked blade rewards critical hits to those skilled enough to strike with finesse.

Kronen.desc: The Kronen resurrects a lethal fighting style once thought lost to the ages.

Kronen Prime.desc: Ancient blades, perfected for today’s combat.

Kuva Ghoulsaw.desc: The addition of Kuva has forged the savage Ghoulsaw into an even more brutal weapon, allowing for faster attacks.

Kuva Shildeg.desc: A crushing, killing, rocket-powered stab-hammer. Grineer, naturally.

Lacera.desc: In the practiced hands of a master, this blade and whip becomes exceedingly devastating.

Lecta.desc: Half taser, half whip. The Corpus Lecta delivers a deadly shock to anything it touches.

Lesion.desc: An instrument of unrelenting harm. If Lesion tastes blood, it becomes invigorated with faster Attack Speed and increased <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage.

Machete.desc: A ferocious Melee Weapon crafted by the Grineer and carried by their elite melee forces.

Machete Wraith.desc: A different take on a familiar combat knife, the Machete Wraith features unique styling.

Magistar.desc: The Magistar mace wields justice and truth in the form of bone-crushing blows.

Masseter.desc: Tear and chew through enemies with this unusual crankshaft-style greatsword. When wielded by Grendel he is immune to staggers and knockdowns during heavy attacks.

Masseter Prime.desc: A greatsword for those with an insatiable hunger for victory. Grendel is immune to crowd-control when he performs Heavy Attacks with this weapon.

Mios.desc: This bone-forged sword includes a tendon-whip to distract and maim the enemy.

Mire.desc: A relic from the Great Plague, the Mire Infested Sword is a brutal weapon. It not only cuts into the enemy, it infects the wounds of its victim with a toxic nerve poison. Deals <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage on Ground Sla

Mk1-Bo.desc: The MK1-Bo is the standard issue staff weapon for all Tenno.

Mk1-Furax.desc: The MK1-Furax is the standard issue fist weapon for all Tenno.

Nami Skyla.desc: Like the surge and crash of storm waves, a master of the Nami cutlass and Skyla dagger turns these two separate weapons into one fluid attack.

Nami Skyla Prime.desc: Forged by a forgotten master, these exquisite blades are bounty from a golden-age long gone.

Nami Solo.desc: Evoking the oceans of earth, this exquisite cutlass is a deadly work of art.

Nepheri.desc: The dual flaming fang-blades of the Archon Amar. Has a unique Neutral Combo that blasts out four short-range fireballs.

Nikana.desc: The Nikana reintroduces a lost Tenno blade and with it another fragment of the old ways.

Nikana Prime.desc: An ancient blade predating the fall of the Orokin Empire. Forged using techniques lost over the centuries, the edge remains sharper than that of any modern Nikana.

Ninkondi.desc: With its lightning-fast strikes, the Ninkondi pays respect to the old ways.

Ninkondi Prime.desc: An ancient weapon imbued with a new truth.

Obex.desc: The Obex system multiplies the kinetic energy of a Tenno's kicks and punches, delivering devastating blows to any target.

Ohma.desc: Bring the enemy to its knees with these twin electrified tonfas.

Okina.desc: Perforate enemies with these two needle-sharp sai.

Okina Prime.desc: Enforce authority with these fine-edged sai blades.

Orthos.desc: The Tenno forged Orthos is a rare double bladed polearm. Those who take the time to master it speak of its impressive striking distance and ability to hit multiple targets.

Orthos Prime.desc: Orthos Prime is an ancient Orokin martial weapon, forged from the purest Rubedo making it extremely light-weight.

Orvius.desc: Turn foes into puppets with Teshin’s versatile throwing disc.

Pangolin Prime.desc: A classic Tenno blade, beautifully reimagined.

Pangolin Sword.desc: A unique blade used by an old Tenno clan.

Paracesis.desc: The Sentient slayer. An offering from Ballas.

Pathocyst.desc: Each strike of this infested glaive infects its target with viral pathogens. Occasionally, it discharges the spores of rabid, enemy-seeking maggots, either in-flight or on contact with the enemy.

Pennant.desc: The steel flag of Old War Railjack crews, the Pennant was invaluable in repelling boarders. With each heavy attack kill the Pennant's speed of attack increases.

Plasma Sword.desc: An advanced blade that delivers high-damage attacks. Delivers a high percentage of critical strikes.

Praedos.desc: Orokin elites admired farmers in conquered regions, because they had learned to fight with modified farming tools despite being forbidden to own weapons. For their voyage, the Zariman were presented with Praedos in recog

Pride.desc: The pride of one that knows their worth. Sirius' signature Heavy Scythe.

Prisma Dual Cleavers.desc: Blades of energized prisma crystal make these ornamental cleavers cut as sharply as they look.

Prisma Machete.desc: The addition of Prisma Crystal allows this otherwise barbaric weapon to elegantly hack through any foe.

Prisma Obex.desc: Dazzle, distract and destroy with these sparring weapons of impossibly hard prisma crystal.

Prisma Ohma.desc: Prisma crystals glisten in these electrified tonfas.

Prisma Skana.desc: Forged from raw prisma crystals and infused with Void energy, this blade's pristine edge is honed razor-sharp to eviscerate even the most deadly of foes.

Prova.desc: The Prova is a Melee Weapon that delivers a high-intensity shock to its target.

Prova Vandal.desc: A customized version of the vicious Prova, with metallic finish and Lotus decal.

Pulmonars.desc: Pummel and infect with these two pulsating hunks of flesh connected by a ligament. Take-hold of the malignant evolution of an ancient martial weapon.

Pupacyst.desc: A two-pronged attack; the bone-grafted cocoon at the tip of this polearm rends flesh, while the viral mass living within spreads itself into the wounds of each new victim.

Quassus.desc: Flick away the enemy with this heavy warfan. The Quassus scatters ethereal daggers that are even more deadly accurate when wielded by Xaku.

Quassus Prime.desc: Wield Xaku Prime’s elegant fan, its gilded edges crafted for both precision and prestige.

Rakta Dark Dagger.desc: Infiltrate undetected; reduced visibility when held. Then strike with confidence; hits to irradiated targets restores shields and creates overshields.

Reaper Prime.desc: Reaper Prime is an ornamental scythe, with a blade forged from tempered Rubedo.

Redeemer.desc: Striking with massive twin blades, the Redeemer fires the killing blow with its built-in shotgun.

Redeemer Prime.desc: Deal double-bladed, double-barreled death with this primed gunblade.

Rumblejack.desc: An electrified jolter for quick melee takedowns, assembled from scavenged scrap. Ideal for use on unsuspecting opponents.

Ruvox.desc: Albrecht's Void experiments revealed the true destructive potential of this fist weapon. In Incarnon form, perform Heavy Slams to impale nearby enemies with spikes.

Sampotes.desc: A warrior who prefers brute force will make the most of Sampotes. Its Slams and Heavy Slams have an extended area of effect.

Sancti Magistar.desc: Each charged attack turns the enemy’s pain into a healing pulse that washes over allies. Also, creates resistance to Status Effects when held.

Sarofang.desc: Mete out the sharp pain of justice. Heavy Slam attacks create a vortex that pulls in lifted enemies when the Sarofang’s Combo Multiplier builds to 8x. In Voruna’s hands, the Sarofang only requires a 5x Combo Multiplier t

Sarofang Prime.desc: Voruna Prime's signature axe is adorned with Orokin gold. She personally ensured that the former owners would have no further use for it.

Sarpa.desc: Makes sweeping cuts punctuated by bursts of heavy gunfire.

Scindo.desc: The Scindo is a heavy war axe crafted by the Tenno. Reduced speed and agility is balanced by heavy, devastating strikes capable of connecting with multiple targets at once.

Scindo Prime.desc: An ancient executioners weapon, the honor of decapitation by the Scindo Prime was reserved for the Orokin's most respected enemies.

Scoliac.desc: The Scoliac Whip is a nasty parasitic growth of sinew and bone that can inflict heart stopping <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage with attacks.

Secura Lecta.desc: Whip the enemy out of their ill-gotten gains; double credit drops on kills.

Serro.desc: Developed as an energy saw to scrap obsolete ships, this tool was quickly banned when rebels in the Sedna region discovered it also made an excellent weapon.

Shaku.desc: With these blazing fast nunchaku, the enemy will never know what hit them.

Sheev.desc: Built for close combat, the Sheev's plasma blade slices through flesh and armor with equal ease.

Sibear.desc: Ice in motion can crush mountains, this frozen hammer is no different.

Sigma & Octantis.desc: Deadly slashes from the Sigma sword are matched only by the force of the Octantis shield when thrown from the air.

Silva & Aegis.desc: This fiery sword and shield combination perfects the balance of Tenno offense and defense prowess. In the hands of a Master, even a defensive tool like a shield can be used as a weapon.

Silva & Aegis Prime.desc: A perfectly crafted pairing, this mace and shield combination is sculpted for exhibition but balanced for the battlefield.

Skana.desc: Before all other weapons, Tenno master the Skana. This simple blade becomes immensely powerful in the hands of a master. For Tenno, it is the foundation of their fighting style and a pillar of their culture.

Skana Prime.desc: A basic blade known as a Skana. It is widely used by the Tenno. Prime model offers slightly increased damage.

Skiajati.desc: Forged of steel grafted from Umbra's flesh, this elegant Nikana unites with its Warframe to form a single being of seething purpose.

Slaytra.desc: The Slaytra is a powerful reiteration of the traditional Grineer Machete that doubles the duration of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effects.

Spinnerex.desc: Each lash of Oraxia's whip injects its victim with a dose of deadly toxin. Upon death, afflicted enemies have a chance to burst, damaging nearby enemies and spreading the poison.

Stropha.desc: A short-blade melee weapon with an ace up its sleeve. Send nearby enemies flying with a powerful short-range shockwave.

Syam.desc: Syam is at home in the hands of a focused warrior. Its Heavy Attacks send forth shockwaves.

Sydon.desc: Inflict maximum devastation with this massive Grineer trident.

Synoid Heliocor.desc: This intelligent hammer takes an enemy killed by a Heavy Attack and recomposes them as an ally. Any fatal strike with this weapon also performs a Codex scan.

Tak & Lug.desc: Take active defense to new heights with this deadly flying shield and brutal blade. Throw the shield with a unique Heavy Attack, inflicting Blast Status Effects and dealing damage in a wide area.

Tatsu.desc: Fearsome and noble, the elegant two-handed Nikana is the pride of any Arsenal. Kills build charges and seeking projectiles are unleashed with a Slide Attack to find and stun unwitting enemies. When Revenant wields this b

Tatsu Prime.desc: Tatsu Prime glows with spectral splendor. It grows more powerful with each enemy’s demise, especially when wielded by Revenant.

Tekko.desc: These iron fists that rip through foes are Atlas' signature weapons. When wielded by Atlas they receive a Status Chance increase.

Tekko Prime.desc: As merciless and indestructible as Atlas Prime himself, Tekko Prime crush and split with tectonic force.

Telos Boltace.desc: Spinning attacks unleash the Stormpath, a tempest of mayhem that hurls any foes in its way.

Tenet Agendus.desc: Drive the agenda with this massive impact hammer. Heavy attacks launch devastating energy disks.

Tenet Exec.desc: Leverage bleeding-edge Granum tech with this massive heavy blade. Slam sends forth a cascading set of three shockwaves, while Heavy Slam unleashes a swath of shockwaves.

Tenet Livia.desc: The sleek lines of the Granum Attaché case conceal an infinitely sharp two-handed blade. Blocked attacks have a chance to increase the blocking angle. Note: The Granum Attaché system pauses the combo timer when holstered

Thalys.desc: The Thalys played a ceremonial role in the Zariman harvest festival, and was intended to reap the first fruits of Tau. Now twisted from this purpose, it plants Void shards in enemy flesh instead. Each new shard planted c

Tipedo.desc: With its crescent shaped blades flying in sweeping arcs and striking at tremendous speed, the Tipedo demands focus from those wishing to unlock its true power.

Tipedo Prime.desc: With their final breath they look to the moon, and are gone.

Tonbo.desc: During the darkest days of the Old War many a Tenno relied solely on the Tonbo to keep them alive.

Tonkkatt.desc: Rend enemies and up the heat with these mining tools repurposed into machine-tonfa. Building the Combo Multiplier overheats the Tonkkatts, setting enemies ablaze.

Twin Basolk.desc: These nasty, little hatchets slice through steel as if it were flesh.

Twin Krohkur.desc: Battlefield butchery becomes all too easy with a Krohkur blade in each hand.

Vastilok.desc: Slash and blast with this heavy Gunblade of brutal Grineer design. High slash damage paired with a heavy shotgun attack.

Vaykor Sydon.desc: Justice blinds. Block hits to charge a Radial Blind, when fully charged Block+Heavy Attack to unleash it.

Venato.desc: Caliban’s signature scythe, forged from a limb wrenched off a fallen Eidolon centuries ago. 50% increased Melee Combo Counter Chance when wielded by Caliban.

Venato Prime.desc: Fashioned from the willingly donated bone of the Sentient Ur-Hatho and embellished by Orokin luxurator Sembik Vol, Venato Prime was to be wielded against 'common enemies' of the united peoples – had any ever emerged from

Venka.desc: Utilizing a new fighting stance, this Tenno weapon turns fists into claws and enemies into messy piles of meat and scrap metal.

Venka Prime.desc: Gleaming blades of white draw blood of the deepest red.

Verdilac.desc: Archon Nira’s spine-shattering whip. Has a unique Tactical Combo that whips out a wide wave of energy with each stroke.

Vericres.desc: Unfurl this warfan like a rapidly waxing moon.

Vitrica.desc: The sword the fabled Orokin executioner Nihil used to glass the condemned. Swing while Aim Gliding to glass enemies. A Ground Slam will smash nearby glassed foes, while sending forward a narrow shockwave to shatter dista

Volnus.desc: Tear and maim with this agile, lightweight glass hammer. When Gara's wields her signature melee weapon, it gains additional Slam Radial Damage.

Volnus Prime.desc: The glorious original Orokin casting of Gara’s signature glass hammer. Deceptively light and swift, while remaining lethally effective.

War.desc: The Stalker's sword as bestowed on him by the Sentient Hunhow.

War Prime.desc: The blade of the world-destroyer reaches its apotheosis, severing conflict itself. In forging this weapon, you have brought unrealized dreams to their ultimate conclusion.

Wolf Sledge.desc: The signature weapon of the only lunatic fearsome enough to bust out of the Saturn Six Max-Pen. Once loosed this formidable throwing hammer always finds its way home.

Wrath.desc: The wrath of one who knows revenge is all about timing. Orion's signature Heavy Scythe.

Xoris.desc: An obscure glaive weapon of Corpus provenance, intrinsically linked to Specter technology. The Xoris strikes rapidly and with great devastation. It is capable of chaining combos infinitely.

Zenistar.desc: Scorch enemies with blistering blows, or set them ablaze with the flying fire disc.

Carrier.desc: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Ammo Case' as default Precepts, Carrier is a seeker Sentinel. Carrier also comes with a shotgun weapon.

Carrier Prime.desc: This ornate sentinel is an excellent example of late Orokin craftsmanship and styling.

Dethcube.desc: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Vaporize' as default precepts, Dethcube acts exactly as advertised, as a badass cube of 'deth'. Comes loaded with Deth Machine Rifle weapon.

Dethcube Prime.desc: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Vaporize' as default precepts, Dethcube Prime is the apex of lethal support. Comes loaded with Deth Machine Rifle Prime weapon.

Diriga.desc: Diriga shocks nearby enemies, and picks off distant threats, utilizing the Vulklok sniper rifle and the 'Calculated Shot', 'Arc Coil' and 'Electro Pulse' precepts.

Djinn.desc: With 'Thumper' and 'Fatal Attraction' as default Precepts, Djinn is a combat Sentinel. Djinn also comes with a poison dart weapon.

Helios.desc: With 'Investigator' as its unique Precept and 'Deconstructor' as its weapon, the versatile Helios Sentinel acts as both a lethal guardian and an automatic codex scanner. Scans require an equipped Codex Scanner and an ava

Helios Prime.desc: This knowledge hungry protector defends its master with Deconstructor Prime.

Nautilus.desc: With 'Auto Omni' and 'Cordon' as default Precepts, this Sentinel is the ideal companion for long voyages aboard a Railjack.

Nautilus Prime.desc: This brave deckhand defends his crew with Verglas Prime.

Oxylus.desc: With 'Scan Aquatic Lifeforms' and 'Scan Matter' as default Precepts, Oxylus was designed to assist in Search-and-Rescue operations through the harsh landscape around The Orb Vallis. Oxylus also comes with a Multron rifle

Prisma Shade.desc: A rare jewel of the void. How could anything so beautiful be crafted for stealth?

Shade.desc: With 'Revenge' and 'Ghost' as default Precepts, Shade is well suited for stealth gameplay. Shade also comes with a burst laser pistol.

Shade Prime.desc: Shade Prime specializes in stealth and comes locked and loaded with the Burst Laser Prime. Together, you can dominate the shadows.

Taxon.desc: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Molecular Conversion' as default Precepts, Taxon protects its owner with shield restoration. Equipped with the Artax ice-beam.

Wyrm.desc: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Crowd Dispersion' as default Precepts, Wyrm is a highly offensive Sentinel. Wyrm also comes with a laser rifle.

Wyrm Prime.desc: Both bodyguard and status symbol, the Wyrm Prime Sentinel was the last line of defense for high ranking Tenno in the Orokin Era.

Adarza Kavat.desc: A vicious and deadly Kavat prized for its combat prowess, offering increased critical chance and punishing those that dare attack it.

Chesa Kubrow.desc: A clever accomplice, trained to relieve the enemy of both their weapons and their loot caches.

Crescent Vulpaphyla.desc: Fast and foxy, Vulpaphyla are agile allies to bring along on your next adventure.

Helminth Charger.desc: An experimental blending of Kubrow and Infestation. Uses maggots and other Infested abilities to inflict damage and control the battlefield.

Huras Kubrow.desc: A stealthy ally, surprising enemies with impressive takedowns of explosive force.

Medjay Predasite.desc: These hard-charging, four-legged predators make formidable companions when in the field.

Panzer Vulpaphyla.desc: Fast and foxy, Vulpaphyla are agile allies to bring along on your next adventure.

Pharaoh Predasite.desc: These hard-charging, four-legged predators make formidable companions when in the field.

Raksa Kubrow.desc: A strong guardian focused on protecting its master by bolstering their defense and by driving away attackers.

Sahasa Kubrow.desc: A reliable partner that locates supplies for their Tenno master and while thinning enemy ranks.

Sly Vulpaphyla.desc: Fast and foxy, Vulpaphyla are agile allies to bring along on your next adventure.

Smeeta Kavat.desc: This sly feline is playful yet devious.

Sunika Kubrow.desc: Bred by the Orokin for combat. This martial beast lives to create chaos and bring down the most fierce opponents.

Vasca Kavat.desc: Now free of the Vasca virus, these Kavats can transfuse life to extend not only their own health but that of their master.

Venari.desc: Khora's loyal Kavat. Her constant companion and protector.

Venari Prime.desc: Khora's will, Venari's fangs and claws.

Vizier Predasite.desc: These hard-charging, four-legged predators make formidable companions when in the field.

Elytron.desc: This heavy duty Archwing was designed for one purpose, destruction.

Itzal.desc: Designed for quick clandestine attacks, the Itzal Archwing excels at striking from the darkness of space.

Odonata.desc: The systems built into this Archwing balance offensive capabilities with defensive countermeasures.

Odonata Prime.desc: This enhanced version of the first Archwing prototype takes the design to its theoretical limits.

Arbucep.desc: Nokko’s signature archgun fires six homing missiles, each bearing a payload of one of the six combined elements which detonate in an area upon impact.

Corvas.desc: When fully charged, this flak cannon delivers a devastating shot. Perfect for taking down fast-moving interceptors.

Corvas Prime.desc: Flaunting ceremonial beauty, this arch gun flak cannon is even more devastating than its standard issue counterpart.

Cyngas.desc: Unload deadly accurate bursts of mayhem.

Dual Decurion.desc: Delivering twin streams of highly accurate, rapid-fire ordnance, the Decurion are specifically designed for combat in the vacuum of space.

Fluctus.desc: An Archwing energy weapon that sends waves of deadly plasma crashing into enemies.

Grattler.desc: Shatter your targets with explosive shells from this devastating Archwing cannon.

Imperator.desc: A long range rifle capable of firing in space, the Imperator's versatility makes it an ideal weapon for space combat.

Imperator Vandal.desc: The Imperator Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the barrel.

Kuva Ayanga.desc: Sweep aside hordes of enemies with flaming fury of this powerful, automatic, grenade launching archgun.

Kuva Grattler.desc: Reconfigured for maximum lethality, the Kuva Grattler still shatters targets with explosive shells, but now reaches maximum fire-rate instantaneously.

Larkspur Prime.desc: Embrace pandemonium. Chainfire and explosive potential meet in Larkspur Prime. Hildryn packs more ammo when she wields this mighty weapon.

Morgha.desc: Blast through enemies with a double-barreled shot of energized slugs. This siphons their life essence which is then used to generate the secondary fire's massive air-burst mortar. The ancient Entrati weapon was built for

Phaedra.desc: Devastate free-space enemies with Phaedra, the Soma's big-sister.

Velocitus.desc: When fully charged, the magnetized barrel of the Velocitus accelerates a metal slug to tremendous speeds, piercing hulls and obliterating armor.

Agkuza.desc: Tear apart incoming enemies with this massive hooked blade.

Centaur.desc: Part sword, part shield, the Centaur excels at charging headlong into enemy fire.

Kaszas.desc: Become an angel of death, with this Archwing scythe.

Knux.desc: Gallium-alloy gauntlets for close-range Archwing combat. Designed by the infamous Tyl Regor.

Onorix.desc: This laser bladed battle-axe easily hacks through a ship's defenses and the forces protecting it.

Prisma Veritux.desc: A rare object of beauty, this Archwing sword has been sheathed in prisma crystal and baptized in the Void’s energy.

Rathbone.desc: Using Archwing's jets for thrust, this massive hammer crushes anything in its path.

Veritux.desc: Weightless space turns this impossibly massive sword into an agile instrument of destruction.
